basic_info.description: Rare mid-century home on a wide, end street in the vibrant Excelsior. Lovingly cared for by the same family for over forty years, this three bed, two bath home, has one of the most desirable floor plans available with all bedrooms and baths on one level. The ground floor has plenty of room to expand. Situated on a flat lot, it is literally steps to the Crocker Amazon Baseball Field and stone's throw away from McLaren Park. Enjoy the great outdoors with lots of hiking trails, play a round of golf at Gleneagles GC, work up a sweat with a round of tennis or pickleball, or enjoy a concert at the Jerry Garcia Amphitheater. Conveniences include groceries stores just minutes away and lots of restaurants nearby. You can experience the vibrancy of city life with the peace of the suburbs, all in one place. Easy access to freeways and transportation is the icing on the cake! With two car side by side parking, also a rarity, you can be confident in a home that has enough room for a family and more!
